name: MCP Server
description: FastMCP server entrypoint that exposes Transmogrifier linguistic register normalization as MCP tools for Claude Code integration. Provides tools for translating text to optimal registers, detecting input register, and listing cached model profiles.

functions.name: main
functions.description: MCP server entry point. Initializes FastMCP server with transmogrifier tools and runs stdio transport.
postconditions: FastMCP server is initialized with name 'transmogrifier'
Three MCP tools are registered: transmog_translate, transmog_detect, transmog_profiles
Server runs on stdio transport (blocking call)
side_effects: Prints error message to stderr if mcp.server.fastmcp is not installed
Exits process with code 1 if dependencies missing

structured_side_effects.description: Error message when MCP dependencies are missing
Exits process with code 1 on ImportError
Runs blocking MCP server on stdio transport

functions.name: transmog_translate
functions.description: Translate text to optimal register for the target model. Nested function registered as MCP tool within main().

error_cases.name: invalid_register
error_cases.condition: target_register is provided but not a valid Register enum value

preconditions: target_register, if provided, must be valid Register enum value
postconditions: Returns dict representation of TranslationResult via model_dump()
Result contains translated text and metadata
side_effects: Calls Transmogrifier.translate() which may invoke LLM backend

structured_side_effects.description: May call external LLM API for translation

functions.name: transmog_detect
functions.description: Detect the register of input text. Nested function registered as MCP tool within main().

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Text to analyze for register detection

postconditions: register is the enum value string representation

functions.name: transmog_profiles
functions.description: List all cached model register sensitivity profiles. Nested function registered as MCP tool within main().
postconditions: Returns list of dicts, each representing a model profile via model_dump()
May return empty list if no profiles cached

invariants: Transmogrifier instance (_t) is initialized once per main() invocation
All nested tool functions close over the same _t instance

data_access.rationale: MCP server reads from stdin, writes to stdout for tool invocation protocol

side_effects.rationale: transmog_translate may invoke external LLM backends via Transmogrifier
Transmogrifier maintains internal caches for profiles and translations
